chunks: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm you?
ai.seo_question: What do the idols claim to do for their worshippers according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this fragment underscores the Shia theological emphasis on Tawhid by contrasting the absolute agency of Allah with the inherent impotence of idols, which possess neither independent benefit nor harm. It serves as a rhetorical dismantling of polytheistic beliefs, reinforcing that all power (qudrah) and will (iradah) belong solely to the Divine.
